name: Goblet Dumbbell Squat
instructions: Stand shoulder-width apart, flare toes 20° outward.
Hold dumbbell vertically against upper chest with palms under the top plate.
Inhale deep into belly, push hips backward and bend knees until thighs hit parallel.
Drive through midfoot, exhale forcefully at top lockout.

demo_steps.title: Torso & Horn Grip
demo_steps.description: Cup dumbbell against sternum like a goblet, elbows tucked tight to ribs.

demo_steps.title: The Descent
demo_steps.description: Hinge hips slightly back then drop straight down between heels.

demo_steps.title: Concentric Drive
demo_steps.description: Push the ground away to return to full upright lockout.

name: Dumbbell Front Squat
instructions: Rest two dumbbells on front shoulders with elbows pointing forward.
Keep torso completely upright as you descend into a deep squat.
Drive up through heels while keeping elbows lifted.

demo_steps.title: Front Rack Anchor
demo_steps.description: Rest heads of dumbbells on deltoids.

demo_steps.title: Deep Knee Flexion
demo_steps.description: Squat down with vertical torso angle.

demo_steps.title: Quad Drive
demo_steps.description: Drive vertically to lockout.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
instructions: Take a wide stance (1.5x shoulder width) with toes angled 45° outward.
Hold single dumbbell hanging straight down between legs.
Squat straight down, pushing knees wide along toe angle.
Squeeze inner thighs and glutes to return to stand.

demo_steps.title: Wide Stance
demo_steps.description: Set feet wide, toes flared 45 degrees.

demo_steps.title: Adductor Descent
demo_steps.description: Drop hips straight down, knees opening wide.

demo_steps.title: Glute Lockout
demo_steps.description: Drive up and contract glutes forcefully.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
instructions: Hold two dumbbells against front of thighs with soft, unlocked knees.
Push hips backward as if trying to touch the wall behind you.
Lower dumbbells grazing along shins until hamstrings reach peak stretch.
Drive hips forward by contracting glutes and hamstrings to return to standing.
common_mistakes: Squatting down instead of hip hinging

demo_steps.title: The Hinge Setup
demo_steps.description: Stand tall, soft knees, shoulder blades packed.

demo_steps.title: Posterior Glide
demo_steps.description: Slide hips back as dumbbells shave shins.
demo_steps.coachTip: Stop when hips stop moving back.

demo_steps.title: Hip Extension
demo_steps.description: Drive hips forward into the dumbbells.

name: Dumbbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Keep knees nearly straight with minimal micro-bend.
Hinge at the hips, keeping back flat as weights descend lower toward ankles.
Feel intense loaded stretch in hamstrings before reversing.
form_cues: Knees almost locked but not hyperextended
common_mistakes: Jerking the weights at the bottom

demo_steps.title: Fixed Knee Angle
demo_steps.description: Set minimal micro-bend in knees and lock the joint angle.

demo_steps.title: Deep Stretch Descent
demo_steps.description: Hinge pure at hips down to mid-shin.

demo_steps.title: Hamstring Pull
demo_steps.description: Pull torso upright purely with hamstrings.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides.
Take a controlled step backward and lower back knee until it hovers 1 inch above floor.
Front shin stays vertical.
Push through front heel to step back forward.
common_mistakes: Forward knee pushing past toes uncontrollably

demo_steps.title: Backward Step
demo_steps.description: Step back smoothly onto ball of rear foot.

demo_steps.title: Double 90° Bend
demo_steps.description: Lower until front and rear knees form 90 degrees.

demo_steps.title: Front Leg Drive
demo_steps.description: Power forward through front midfoot.

name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge
instructions: Step forward with dumbbells at sides.
Decelerate smoothly and bend both knees.
Push explosively off the front heel to return to start.

demo_steps.title: Lunge Entry
demo_steps.description: Step forward cleanly.

demo_steps.title: Braking Phase
demo_steps.description: Absorb impact through quadriceps.

demo_steps.title: Push Back
demo_steps.description: Explode off lead heel back to starting stance.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward continuously, alternating legs with each stride.
Maintain steady fluid pace without rushing.
Keep dumbbells steady at sides without swinging.

demo_steps.title: Lead Step
demo_steps.description: Step forward into lunge.

demo_steps.title: Transition
demo_steps.description: Drive directly through front heel into the next stride.

demo_steps.title: Stride Rhythm
demo_steps.description: Continue smoothly alternating legs.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Place rear foot laces-down on flat bench behind you.
Lower hips down and slightly back until front thigh is parallel to floor.
Push aggressively through front heel to return to top.
form_cues: Lean slightly forward to bias glutes
common_mistakes: Pushing off rear foot instead of front leg

demo_steps.title: Bench Placement
demo_steps.description: Rest rear shoelaces on flat bench.

demo_steps.title: Descent
demo_steps.description: Lower straight down until front thigh is parallel.

demo_steps.title: Drive
demo_steps.description: Push directly through front midfoot to stand.

name: Static Split Squat
instructions: Set feet in stationary staggered split stance.
Perform all reps on one leg before switching, without moving feet between reps.

demo_steps.title: Split Anchor
demo_steps.description: Set wide split stance on floor.

demo_steps.title: Vertical Reps
demo_steps.description: Pump reps up and down smoothly.

demo_steps.title: Side Switch
demo_steps.description: Complete sets on both legs.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
instructions: Place entire foot on flat bench.
Drive through top foot to stand atop bench.
Lower back down with controlled 2-second negative.
form_cues: Lead leg does 90% of the work
Do not jump off bottom foot

demo_steps.title: Bench Footing
demo_steps.description: Plant entire foot on bench surface.

demo_steps.title: Top Leg Lift
demo_steps.description: Stand up without jumping off back foot.

demo_steps.title: Slow Descent
demo_steps.description: Step down softly.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
instructions: Step wide to the side, pushing hips backward as you bend the stepping knee.
Keep non-stepping leg completely straight.
Push off side heel to return to center.
form_cues: Hips push back like a squat on one side

demo_steps.title: Side Step
demo_steps.description: Step wide to lateral side.

demo_steps.title: Lateral Hinge
demo_steps.description: Sink hips back on stepping leg.

demo_steps.title: Center Push
demo_steps.description: Push off outside foot back to start.

name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat.
Rest dumbbell securely across hips.
Drive through heels to lift hips until thighs and torso align.
Squeeze glutes hard for 2 seconds at top.
form_cues: Squeeze glutes, do not arch lower back

demo_steps.title: Floor Setup
demo_steps.description: Lie supine, knees at 90°, dumbbell on hip crease.

demo_steps.title: Hip Lift
demo_steps.description: Bridge hips upward into lockout.

demo_steps.title: Glute Peak
demo_steps.description: Hold contraction 2 seconds.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Anchor upper shoulder blades against flat bench edge.
Place heavy dumbbell across pelvis.
Lower hips toward floor then thrust upward until torso and thighs form a flat bridge.

demo_steps.title: Bench Anchor
demo_steps.description: Rest mid-scapula on edge of bench.

demo_steps.title: Thrust
demo_steps.description: Drive hips skyward through heels.

demo_steps.title: Horizontal Tabletop
demo_steps.description: Hold flat bridge position.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on floor with one knee bent and other leg extended straight.
Drive through working heel to lift pelvis.
Keep hips level and square throughout.

demo_steps.title: Single Leg Anchor
demo_steps.description: One foot flat on floor, opposite leg floating.

demo_steps.title: One-Leg Bridge
demo_steps.description: Press working heel down to elevate hips.

demo_steps.title: Level Top
demo_steps.description: Hold level at top for 1 count.

name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides with balls of feet on a raised plate rim.
Lower heels down into deep stretch.
Press onto big toes to raise as high as possible, holding peak for 1 second.

demo_steps.title: Plate Edge Setup
demo_steps.description: Balls of feet on plate edge, heels hanging.

demo_steps.title: Deep Stretch
demo_steps.description: Drop heels below plate rim.

demo_steps.title: High Peak
demo_steps.description: Rise onto balls of feet, contracting calves.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Hold one dumbbell in hand on working side.
Perform high-range calf raises on a single foot.
Control the tempo strictly (3s down, 1s hold, 1s up).

demo_steps.title: Single Foot Anchor
demo_steps.description: Balance on ball of one foot.

demo_steps.title: Controlled Reps
demo_steps.description: Lower into stretch, rise to ceiling.

demo_steps.title: Peak Squeeze
demo_steps.description: Contract calf muscle hard.

name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Sit tall on bench set to 90° with knees at 90° angle.
Place dumbbells across knees with balls of feet on floor/plate.
Raise heels high to work the deep soleus muscle.
common_mistakes: Cutting the range of motion short

demo_steps.title: Seated Setup
demo_steps.description: Sit on 90° bench, dumbbells resting on knees.

demo_steps.title: Heel Drop
demo_steps.description: Drop heels into deep stretch.

demo_steps.title: Soleus Push
demo_steps.description: Push onto toes to maximum height.

name: Dumbbell Good Morning
instructions: Hold single dumbbell horizontally across upper chest.
Hinge backward at hips with flat spine and soft knees.
Lower torso to near-parallel to floor, then contract hamstrings to return to stand.
common_mistakes: Bending knees excessively into a squat

demo_steps.title: Chest Hug
demo_steps.description: Hold dumbbell firm against upper chest.

demo_steps.title: Pure Hinge
demo_steps.description: Hinge hips straight back with flat back.

demo_steps.title: Hamstring Snap
demo_steps.description: Contract glutes and hamstrings to return upright.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold single dumbbell in hand opposite working leg.
Hinge forward while extending non-working leg straight behind you in line with torso.
Touch dumbbell toward mid-shin, then drive working hip forward.
form_cues: Torso and back leg form straight line
Square hips to floor, do not rotate open

demo_steps.title: Single Leg Setup
demo_steps.description: Stand on one foot, soft knee, dumbbell opposite side.

demo_steps.title: Airplane Hinge
demo_steps.description: Hinge forward as rear leg elevates like a see-saw.

demo_steps.title: Hip Power
demo_steps.description: Drive through standing foot to stand tall.

name: Flat Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on flat bench, dumbbells held at chest level with neutral wrists.
Drive feet into floor, retract scapulae firmly into the pad.
Press dumbbells up in a slight inward arc without clanking at top.
Lower with 3-second controlled eccentric to nipple line.
common_mistakes: Shoulders rolling forward off bench at top

demo_steps.title: Bench Lock Setup
demo_steps.description: Retract and depress shoulder blades into bench.

demo_steps.title: Inward Arc Press
demo_steps.description: Press dumbbells up and slightly inward over sternum.

demo_steps.title: Controlled Stretch
demo_steps.description: Lower down slowly until dumbbell handles reach chest level.

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press (30°)
instructions: Set 20-in-1 bench to 30° incline.
Press dumbbells upward over upper chest with tucked elbows.
Lower until dumbbells touch upper clavicle line.
common_mistakes: Bench too steep (turns into shoulder press)

demo_steps.title: Incline Position
demo_steps.description: Lie against 30° backrest, feet planted.

demo_steps.title: Upper Pec Drive
demo_steps.description: Press upward over collarbones.

demo_steps.title: Deep Stretch
demo_steps.description: Lower smoothly with elbows at 45°.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Set 20-in-1 bench to decline angle with leg anchors.
Press dumbbells vertically over lower sternum.
Lower to lower chest border.

demo_steps.title: Decline Anchor
demo_steps.description: Secure legs on decline bench.

demo_steps.title: Lower Pec Line
demo_steps.description: Press over bottom border of chest.

demo_steps.title: Pec Squeeze
demo_steps.description: Squeeze lower chest hard.

name: Flat Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie flat holding dumbbells over chest with slight elbow bend (15°).
Lower arms wide to sides in hugging arc until deep chest stretch is felt.
Squeeze pecs to bring dumbbells back together over chest.

demo_steps.title: Elbow Arch Lock
demo_steps.description: Micro-bend elbows and lock the angle.

demo_steps.title: Wide Arc
demo_steps.description: Open arms wide like wings.

demo_steps.title: Pec Hug
demo_steps.description: Squeeze dumbbells together using inner pecs.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly (30°)
instructions: Set bench to 30°.
Open arms wide maintaining slight elbow bend.
Bring dumbbells together over eye line, squeezing upper chest.
form_cues: Feel loaded stretch in collarbone region

demo_steps.title: Incline Arc
demo_steps.description: Set bench at 30°, arms extended.

demo_steps.title: Eccentric Opening
demo_steps.description: Open wide horizontally.

demo_steps.title: Peak Adduction
demo_steps.description: Squeeze pecs to bring weights together.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on floor with knees bent and feet flat.
Press dumbbells up to arms length.
Lower until triceps lightly touch the floor, pause 1 second to eliminate stretch reflex, then press up.
form_cues: Dead stop on floor eliminates shoulder impingement

demo_steps.title: Floor Anchor
demo_steps.description: Lie supine on mat, feet flat, dumbbells over chest.

demo_steps.title: Dead Stop
demo_steps.description: Lower until upper arms rest on floor.

demo_steps.title: Explosive Push
demo_steps.description: Press up explosively off floor.

name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Press
instructions: Lie on bench with palms facing each other (neutral grip).
Lower dumbbells alongside ribs with elbows tucked tight to torso.
Press upward, focusing on chest squeeze without shoulder strain.

demo_steps.title: Parallel Grip
demo_steps.description: Palms facing inwards toward ribs.

demo_steps.title: Tucked Descent
demo_steps.description: Lower handles grazing close to ribcage.

demo_steps.title: Vertical Drive
demo_steps.description: Press straight up to lockout.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press (Hex Press)
instructions: Press two dumbbells together at their flat inner faces directly over your chest.
Keep squeezing them together forcefully as you lower to sternum and press back to top.
form_cues: Crush dumbbells together with maximum force

demo_steps.title: The Clamp
demo_steps.description: Press plates together tightly over sternum.

demo_steps.title: Tension Descent
demo_steps.description: Lower to chest while maintaining crushing force.

demo_steps.title: Peak Clamp
demo_steps.description: Press to arms length while crushing handles.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on floor with dumbbell in one hand, non-working hand resting on belly.
Press dumbbell while bracing core to prevent torso from rolling toward the weight.
form_cues: Keep both shoulder blades pinned flat

demo_steps.title: Anti-Rotation Setup
demo_steps.description: Hold single dumbbell on one side.

demo_steps.title: Single Side Press
demo_steps.description: Press up while fighting rotational force.

demo_steps.title: Controlled Floor Touch
demo_steps.description: Lower elbow to floor lightly.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie perpendicular across flat bench with only upper shoulders supported.
Hold single dumbbell with diamond grip overhead.
Lower dumbbell backward behind head in gentle arc until deep ribcage stretch is felt.
Pull back over face using pecs and lats.
common_mistakes: Bending elbows excessively (turns into triceps extension)

demo_steps.title: Diamond Grip Setup
demo_steps.description: Palms cup under top plate of dumbbell over eyes.

demo_steps.title: Overhead Arc
demo_steps.description: Lower dumbbell behind head in controlled arc.

demo_steps.title: Pec Pull
demo_steps.description: Pull dumbbell back to vertical position.

name: Standard Strict Push-Up
instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in rigid plank from head to heels.
Lower until chest is 1 inch off floor with elbows at 45°.
Push the ground away to return to top.
form_cues: Body as straight as a steel rod
common_mistakes: Head bobbing instead of chest reaching floor

demo_steps.title: Plank Alignment
demo_steps.description: Hands under shoulders, glutes and abs squeezed tight.

demo_steps.title: Chest to Floor
demo_steps.description: Lower entire body in unison until chest hovers above floor.

demo_steps.title: Floor Push
demo_steps.description: Drive palms into ground to full arm lockout.

name: Incline Push-Up (Hands on Bench)
instructions: Place hands on flat bench edge, feet back on floor in plank.
Lower chest to touch bench edge, then press back up.
form_cues: Ideal for volume burnouts and beginners

demo_steps.title: Bench Hands Setup
demo_steps.description: Hands shoulder-width on bench pad.

demo_steps.title: Pad Touch
demo_steps.description: Lower sternum to graze bench.

demo_steps.title: Press Away
demo_steps.description: Lock arms cleanly.

name: Decline Push-Up (Feet on Bench)
instructions: Place toes on flat bench with hands on floor below shoulders.
Lower until nose and chest hover above floor, then press up.
form_cues: Shifts bodyweight directly onto upper pecs

demo_steps.title: Feet Elevated
demo_steps.description: Place toes on bench surface, hands on mat.

demo_steps.title: Deep Upper Angle
demo_steps.description: Lower chest between hands.

demo_steps.title: Drive
demo_steps.description: Press floor away forcefully.

name: Knee Push-Up
instructions: Set knees on mat, hands under shoulders, torso straight from knees to head.
Perform controlled push-ups to build pressing strength.
form_cues: Straight line from knees to crown

demo_steps.title: Knee Base
demo_steps.description: Knees on mat, torso straight.

demo_steps.title: Full Depth
demo_steps.description: Lower chest to floor.

demo_steps.title: Lockout
demo_steps.description: Press to arm extension.

name: Wide-Grip Push-Up
instructions: Place hands 1.5x shoulder width apart.
Lower chest deeply into stretch, then press up.

demo_steps.title: Wide Base
demo_steps.description: Hands wide on floor.

demo_steps.title: Stretch Drop
demo_steps.description: Lower chest smoothly.

demo_steps.title: Pec Squeeze
demo_steps.description: Drive up through palm heels.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
instructions: Place hands shoulder-width or slightly narrower.
Lower with elbows grazing ribs, pressing through palm heels.
form_cues: Keep elbows pinned tight to ribcage

demo_steps.description: Hands 8-10 inches apart under sternum.

demo_steps.title: Rib Brush
demo_steps.description: Lower with elbows hugging torso.

demo_steps.title: Triceps Lock
demo_steps.description: Drive to straight arm lockout.

name: Dumbbell Crush Press
instructions: Press dumbbells together with maximum force on flat bench, pulsing through mid-range.

demo_steps.title: Crush Setup
demo_steps.description: Push dumbbell faces together with maximum strength.

demo_steps.title: Mid-Range Travel
demo_steps.description: Lower 4 inches above chest.

demo_steps.title: Crush Lockout
demo_steps.description: Press to top while squeezing.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Hold both dumbbells at top lockout.
Lower and press right dumbbell while left dumbbell stays locked overhead. Alternate sides.

demo_steps.title: Top Hold
demo_steps.description: Both dumbbells locked overhead.

demo_steps.title: One Arm Lower
demo_steps.description: Lower one dumbbell smoothly while other stays fixed.

demo_steps.title: Press & Switch

name: Dumbbell Around-the-World
instructions: Lie flat holding light dumbbells with palms facing ceiling.
Sweep dumbbells in wide circle along the floor plane from thighs to overhead, then reverse.

demo_steps.description: Lie flat, light dumbbells at thighs, palms up.

demo_steps.title: Circular Sweep
demo_steps.description: Trace wide circle around body to overhead.

demo_steps.title: Reverse Sweep
demo_steps.description: Trace circle back to hips smoothly.

name: Tempo Push-Up (4-2-1-0)
instructions: Lower for 4 seconds, pause 2 seconds 1 inch off floor, explode up in 1 second, zero rest at top.

demo_steps.title: The 4-Second Drop
demo_steps.description: Count: 1... 2... 3... 4... lowering slowly.

demo_steps.title: The 2-Second Freeze
demo_steps.description: Hold chest 1 inch off floor without touching.

demo_steps.title: Explosive Burst
demo_steps.description: Power to lockout in 1 second.
